scope: Retrospective offline post-estimator policy-input compromise on reused Urban01 NIGHT development. Not raw sensor tampering, a real takeover, or hardware/signed provenance validation.
attack_interval: Endpoint time >= first+(last-first)*2//5 and < first+(last-first)*3//5. Requests consume latest available endpoint causally; no request-time overwriting.
controls: Byte-identical predictions, clocks, quality, binding and deadband from original nominal/dropout archives; both controls must reproduce every historical metric cell. Dropout source reconstruction and feature inference are reused by hash, not rerun.
boundary: Radar cases alter radar-only speed estimate after estimation. Fusion cases alter each fused estimate after correction. Peer cases alter the shared neural peer. No raw feature effect is inferred; common compromise requires authority over the indicated policy inputs. Source quality and clocks remain nominal/previously captured, modeling undetected authorized-output compromise.

cases_explained.radar_plus3: Radar estimate +3; honest peer and fused outputs.
cases_explained.peer_plus3: Peer +3; honest radar and fused outputs.
cases_explained.radar_peer_plus3: Radar and shared peer +3; fused outputs unchanged.
cases_explained.fusion_peer_plus3: All five fused output interfaces and peer +3; radar unchanged.
cases_explained.all_peer_plus3: Radar, all fused output interfaces and peer +3.
cases_explained.dropout: Previously captured IMU dropout, no new compromise.
cases_explained.dropout_radar_plus3: Previously captured IMU dropout; radar +3, honest peer.
cases_explained.dropout_radar_peer_plus3: Previously captured IMU dropout; radar and peer +3.
